scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:build:api && npm run docker:build:web
scripts.docker:build:api: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t omjeem/content-generator-api:latest --push .
scripts.docker:build:web: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t omjeem/content-generator-web:latest --push .
scripts.docker:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.prod.yaml pull && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.prod.yaml up -d
